title: Urugendo rwambukiranya inyanja itagira umutuzo
intro: Tekereza uhagaze ku kirahuri cy'ubwato buremereye cyane mu gihe imiraba irimo kwiyongera, abakozi bagakora ubufindo kugira ngo borohereze umutwaro. Umuntu umwe wenyine araza imbere, yemera iherezo risa n'aho ari iherezo, ariko ikuzimu hahinduka ahantu ho gusenga no kugaruka. Inyuma y'aho hari umuryango waburiwe ibihano biri hafi, imbere hari imbabazi zitunguranye.
clues: Natumwe nk'intumwa ku bantu barenga ibihumbi ijana.
Navuye mu muryango wanjye mfite uburakari mbere yo guhabwa uburenganzira bwo kugenda.
Nagiye mu bwato bwari bwuzuye ibintu byinshi maze abakozi babwo baca ubufindo kugira ngo bamenye uzajugunywa mu nyanja.
Najugunywe mu nyanja maze imira n'ifi nini mu gihe nari mfite icyo nemezwa.
Nasingizaga Imana mu mwijima, mvuga ko nta yindi mana ibaho uretse Yo kandi ko nari umwe mu bakora ibibi.
Najugunywe ku nkombe, ndwaye, maze Imana intera ikimera cy'umurama, abantu banjye bemera maze bahabwa ibyishimo by'igihe runaka.

trial.label: Ni ikigeragezo nahuye nacyo?
options: Yajugunywe mu muriro ikonje kandi itekanye
Yamizwe n'ifi nini nyuma yo guhunga
Abavandimwe b'abanyamururumba bajugunye mu iriba rinini
Yafashwe n'indwara ndende no gutakaza ubuzima
trial.answer: Yamizwe n'ifi nini nyuma yo guhunga

outcome.label: Ingaruka zanjye zari izihe?
options: Nakijijwe no guhabwa icyubahiro maze abantu banjye barizera maze bararokoka igihe gito
Abantu banjye bahinduwe inkende kubera kwica Isabato
Abantu banjye bamizwe n'isi kubera ubwibone
Abantu banjye bafashwe n'igisasu gikomeye cyaturutse mu ijuru
Abantu banjye barohamye kubera umwuzure ukomeye
outcome.answer: Nakijijwe no guhabwa icyubahiro maze abantu banjye barizera maze bararokoka igihe gito

arabic: وَأَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
verse: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more. (37:147)
